art_note: The images are floating 3D renders with flat-pasted graphics, lacking the sophisticated styling and lighting expected of a luxury fashion house.
desc_en: Elevate your urban wardrobe with these high-top sneakers. This design combines sophisticated aesthetics with everyday comfort. Crafted with a durable canvas upper and a breathable cotton lining. They feature a resilient rubber sole and a removable insole for enhanced support. The reinforced toe cap adds a functional finish. Each pair is specially crafted for you upon order, ensuring exclusivity with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Eleve su estilo urbano con estas zapatillas de caña alta. Su diseño combina sofisticación y comodidad para el día a día. Fabricadas con una parte superior de lona resistente y un forro interior de algodón transpirable. Incorporan una suela de goma duradera y una plantilla extraíble para mayor soporte. La puntera reforzada aporta un acabado funcional. Cada par se elabora especialmente para usted bajo pedido, garantizando exclusividad y disponibilidad mundial.
details_en:
· High-quality canvas upper
· Breathable cotton lining
· 7-eyelet lace-up closure
· Rubber sole and removable EVA insole
· Reinforced waterproof PU toe cap
· Made to order
· Worldwide shipping available
